en.html:
Shut up in her room, indulging in a morning's sleep? She had always kept a regular rhythm... Perhaps not now.

In any case, if that was so, she seemed unlikely to become Silver Star and run wild while I was away. Swept along all the way here, I had been wondering whether I ought to return immediately.

How seriously to take this <ruby>outing<rt>・・</rt></ruby>, I could not tell either—a statement applicable to almost everything about the Kubou of Horigoe.
For the present, better follow her wishes.

部屋に閉じ篭もって朝寝を貪っているという事か？
　あれは規則正しい生活リズムを持っていたはずだが
……今は違うのかもしれない。

　ともあれそういう事なら、俺のいない間に銀星号と
なって暴れ出す恐れは無さそうだ。
　引っ張られるまま勢いでここまで来たものの、すぐ
に戻るべきではないのかと考えていたのだが。

　<ruby>遊び<rt>・・</rt></ruby>というのもどこまで本気かわからない――これ
は堀越公方の全てについて言えるが。
　ひとまず、彼女の意向に沿った方が良いだろう。

en.html:
Now she mentioned it.
In the whirl of events, I had forgotten entirely. Yes, that was today.

The Tamura Challenge Cup was an annual <ruby>armored racing<rt>Armor Race</rt></ruby> meet sponsored by Tamura Armor Industries and several other companies. Annual, though its history amounted to only a few years. Not especially large in scale.

But the participating works teams entered machines with next year's contest in mind. Accordingly, <ruby>enthusiasts<rt>fans</rt></ruby> followed it closely.
I had my own experience of struggling to obtain a seat.
en.text:
Now she mentioned it.
In the whirl of events, I had forgotten entirely. Yes, that was today.

The Tamura Challenge Cup was an annual armored racingArmor Race meet sponsored by Tamura Armor Industries and several other companies. Annual, though its history amounted to only a few years. Not especially large in scale.

But the participating works teams entered machines with next year's contest in mind. Accordingly, enthusiastsfans followed it closely.

ja.html:
そういえば。
　多事多端の渦中、すっかり忘れ去っていたが、成程
今日はその当日だ。

　タムラチャレンジカップとは、田村甲業ほか数社が
主催する毎年恒例の――と言っても数年の歴史に過ぎ
ないが――<ruby>装甲競技<rt>アーマーレース</rt></ruby>大会である。
　規模としてはそう大きくもない。

　が、参加する各社のワークスチームは来年の勝負を
見据えた騎体を送り込んでくるため、<ruby>愛好家<rt>ファン</rt></ruby>の注目度
は非常に高かった。
　座席を取るため四苦八苦した経験が俺にもある。
